business_problem: nybl needed a safer and more reliable way to inspect industrial assets because manual inspections in remote or hazardous environments were slow, costly and hard to govern at scale.
solution_summary: nybl integrated its n.vision platform with IBM Maximo Visual Inspection and IBM watsonx.governance to automate industrial inspections while keeping model behavior transparent. Maximo Visual Inspection provides the computer-vision engine that detects, classifies and reports faults from asset imagery so clients no longer need to send people into hard-to-reach or dangerous locations for routine checks. IBM watsonx.governance adds lifecycle transparency, bias and drift monitoring, and compliance management so clients can trust the AI in mission-critical environments. In the combined design, inspection images and observations feed the n.vision workflow, computer-vision outputs are produced through Maximo Visual Inspection and governance controls validate how models are performing over time. The result is an AI-assisted inspection system that reduces human exposure, lowers operating costs and gives industrial operators a governed path to scaling automated asset monitoring.

solution_components.name: IBM Maximo Visual Inspection
solution_components.role: Performs computer-vision-based detection and classification of faults during asset inspections.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.governance
solution_components.role: Monitors AI lifecycle performance, bias, drift and compliance for the inspection models.

solution_components.name: n.vision

data_flow: Inspection imagery and asset observations are processed by Maximo Visual Inspection inside nybl’s n.vision platform, while watsonx.governance continuously evaluates model performance and compliance before results are returned to operators as fault reports.
business_outcome: nybl reduced inspection cost, time and safety risk while providing clients with a governed way to scale AI-based inspection across industrial environments.
